findings.issue: הַפָּסַח is a common noun with the article, not a proper name; Pésaj leaves it untranslated and capitalizes it as a title.
Arrastren narrows the qal imperative of משך to dragging along the ground; the lemma also licenses draw or pull without that manner.

notes: Ustedes imperatives and sus with ustedes remain 2nd-person address.
